---
title: "running_track"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)

running <- read.csv("NCAA_track.csv")

running <- running |> separate(Year, into = c("Class", "Year"), sep = "-")

running <- running |> mutate(Time = ms(Time))

running <- running |> mutate(Time = as.duration(Time))

running <- running |> mutate(EventName = as.factor(Event))
```

```{r}
speed <- running |> mutate(Time = as.double(Time))

speed <- speed |> mutate(Speed = Event/Time)

ggplot(speed, aes(x = log(Event), y = Speed)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth()

desmos <- speed |> select(Event, Speed)

write_csv(desmos, "desmos.csv")

ggplot(speed, aes(x = Event, y = Speed)) +
  geom_point()
```

```{r}
silly <- running |> separate(Athlete, into = c("LastName", "FirstName"), sep = ", ")

silly <- silly |> mutate(FirstLetter = str_sub(FirstName, 1, 1))

silly <- silly |> mutate(Time = as.double(Time))

silly <- silly |> mutate(Speed = Event/Time)

ggplot(silly, aes(x = FirstLetter, y = Place)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(group = FirstLetter))

silly2 <- silly |> mutate(Name1Length = (str_length(FirstName)))

ggplot(silly2, aes(x = Class, y = Name1Length)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(group = Class))
```
